title: 2-D Mean
text: 计算输入数组的二维均值，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；按 {Reset port} 指定重置事件；{Running mean} 指定运行均值、{Find the mean value over} 指定计算均值所沿的维度 Entire、{Dimension} 指定自定义维度、{Enable ROI processing} 指定计算 ROI 内的均值、{ROI type} 指定 ROI 类型、{ROI portion to process} 指定 Portion of ROI for which to compute mean Entire、{Output} 指定 Compute individual or universal mean for ROIs Individual statistics for each、{Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds} 指定 Enable flag output port、{Output flag indicating if input label numbers are valid} 指定 Enable flag output port、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: I
ports.summary: 输入数组 vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输入的均值 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Reset port
params.values: 重置事件 None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Find the mean value over
params.values: 计算均值所沿的维度 Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Enable ROI processing
params.values: 计算 ROI 内的均值 off (default) | on

params.name: ROI type
params.values: ROI 类型 Rectangles (default) | Lines | Label matrix | Binary mask

params.name: ROI portion to process
params.values: Portion of ROI for which to compute mean Entire ROI (default) | ROI perimeter

params.name: Output
params.values: Compute individual or universal mean for ROIs Individual statistics for each ROI (default) | Single statistic for all ROIs

params.name: Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds
params.values: Enable flag output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output flag indicating if input label numbers are valid
params.values: Enable flag output port off (default) | on

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
